parameters.content:
## Vaccination reminders, every morning
Reads the Pets tab and works out who is due from **next_vaccination_due**, or from
**last_vaccination** plus 12 months. Sends at 14 days before, on the day, and 14 days
overdue (`reminder_offsets`), and catches up if a run was missed in the last 3 days.

It skips owners who replied STOP, pets already booked in for a vaccination, and anyone
already reminded for that due date (the **Reminders** tab is the ledger).

**Template needed:** `vaccination_reminder`, 3 body variables (owner, pet, "due on Mon 5
Oct" / "due today" / "overdue..."), and two quick-reply buttons: **Book now** and
**Stop reminders**. Book now drops the owner straight into the diary for that pet.

Staff get a morning summary - including any rows whose dates cannot be read.
